title: wc_crypto2dev_cleanup unconditionally unregisters devId even if manually registered
description: Scenario: Application calls wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice(WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID, custom_cb, ctx) to register its own callback, then calls wc_crypto2dev_init(), then later calls wc_crypto2dev_cleanup(). Bad behavior: cleanup calls wc_CryptoCb_UnRegisterDevice(WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) unconditionally, removing the application's registration, not just the one installed by init. Subsequent crypto operations silently fall through to software. Maintenance consequence: hard-to-reproduce bug when mixing wc_crypto2dev_init/cleanup with manual device registration; init and cleanup should only undo their own registration.
